methods.candidate_workaround: Run non-login, single-surface searches or allowlisted reads with independently measured windows and retain only complete child receipts.
methods.failure_signature: A shared short envelope and then a short login-shell listing timed out before returning complete audit evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer audit completion from a timed-out parent; separate recursive discovery from runner startup and preserve each completed witness independently.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed receipts, make no evidentiary promotion from them, and return to the clean canonical lane before bounded read-only retries.
methods.scope_boundary: Operational audit shaping only; it does not validate proposal novelty, repository content, scientific claims, or independent reproduction.
methods.title: Bounded single-surface audit after shared-envelope timeouts

methods.candidate_workaround: Use an exact file and a single-quoted regex or fixed-string query, then inspect the complete result independently.
methods.failure_signature: A multiply escaped JSON-field alternation reached ripgrep as an invalid unclosed group.
methods.recurrence_guard: Avoid layered backslash escaping for JSON key probes; validate one literal-safe pattern before combining search operations.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure, make no repository inference from it, and rerun only after reducing the quoting layers.
methods.scope_boundary: Search transport only; a successful field probe is not by itself a semantic novelty determination.
methods.title: Literal-safe JSON field probes across PowerShell

methods.candidate_workaround: Traverse the inherited-index chain in one PowerShell process, collecting records after recursion so order and count remain explicit.
methods.failure_signature: An inline Python f-string embedded through PowerShell was corrupted before Python parsing.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use one parser for structured chain walks; if reusable complexity grows, implement a family-named committed runner rather than another inline multilanguage expression.
methods.rollback: Retain the syntax fault, make no proposal-count claim from it, and rerun only with a single-language traversal.
methods.scope_boundary: Index traversal reliability only; complete extraction still requires semantic review for novelty.
methods.title: One-language traversal for chained JSON indices

methods.candidate_workaround: Collect the foreach results in an explicit array and pipe that expression to the serializer.
methods.failure_signature: A direct pipeline from a foreach statement was rejected as an empty pipe element.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use expression collection boundaries around statement output before pipelines on this host.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser error, emit no similarity conclusion, and rerun only the corrected read-only report.
methods.scope_boundary: Report-shaping reliability only; token similarity remains a screen, not proof of semantic novelty.
methods.title: Explicit collection before Windows PowerShell report pipelines

methods.candidate_workaround: Require destination absence, copy only the predecessor scaffold, apply an ordered array of case-sensitive String.Replace pairs, and inspect all stale phase markers before semantic edits.
methods.failure_signature: An inherited PowerShell hash-map rewrite failed because case-insensitive keys collapsed upper- and lower-case phase tokens.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never use a case-insensitive dictionary for phase tokens that differ only by case; never promote a mechanical copy without explicit stale-marker and diff review.
methods.rollback: If creation or inspection fails, retain the fault, remove no history, and leave the unpromoted new files out of the x1 commit until corrected.
methods.scope_boundary: Mechanical version compatibility only; semantic correctness still requires explicit patch review and tests.
methods.title: Case-sensitive ordered-pair compatibility scaffold
trigger_preconditions: replacement tokens differing only by case

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the current UTF-8 source and apply independent semantic regions with exact present context, then compile and inspect stale markers.
methods.failure_signature: A multi-region patch was rejected because one context line had already changed during the mechanical scaffold rewrite.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never assume predecessor context survives a version rewrite; keep semantic patch regions small and verify the resulting file before promotion.
methods.rollback: An atomic rejection changes no file; retain the negative and retry only after exact source inspection.
methods.scope_boundary: Patch transport and semantic targeting only; successful application still requires tests and content review.
methods.title: Small exact-context semantic patches after mechanical rewrites

methods.candidate_workaround: Patch ASCII regions separately, inspect the encoded source directly, and use a small exact-context change for the Unicode region.
methods.failure_signature: A displayed Unicode separator did not match the file's encoded source context and caused atomic patch rejection.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never derive Unicode patch bytes from mojibake-prone output; validate UTF-8 transport before promotion.
methods.rollback: An atomic rejection changes no file; retain the failure and retry only with exact encoded context.
methods.scope_boundary: Encoding and patch transport only; it does not confer cultural authority or validate substantive wording.
methods.title: UTF-8-exact patch regions independent of console rendering

methods.candidate_workaround: Use normalized staged Git blobs for hashes, inspect CRLF and LF counts and diff hygiene explicitly, then require one LF-preserving clean named-lane replay at the exact final head.
methods.failure_signature: Exact staging emitted future LF-to-CRLF working-copy conversion warnings for new text files.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never claim cross-checkout byte parity from a warning-bearing working tree alone; bind manifests to Git blobs and retain the warning until the exact named replay passes.
methods.rollback: Stop before commit if staged blobs, content seals, or diff hygiene disagree; retain the warning and repair only phase-owned files without changing repository-wide configuration.
methods.scope_boundary: Newline and manifest portability only; the later same-owner named replay is not independent reproduction.
methods.title: Git-blob newline domain with clean named-lane replay

methods.candidate_workaround: Use apply-patch for the exact semantic block or keep the transformation in one parser language with no layered newline escapes.
methods.failure_signature: PowerShell backtick-newline escapes broke the outer JavaScript orchestration template before a shell call was made.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never mix PowerShell backtick escapes inside a JavaScript template literal; verify that the outer orchestration source parses before assuming the nested command can run.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure, confirm no shell call or file mutation occurred, and retry only with a single-language edit.
methods.scope_boundary: Orchestration and patch transport only; it does not validate the evidence builder semantics.
methods.title: Single-language block edits across orchestration boundaries
